author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 여름에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)

months.note: 한대 지역에서 번식하고 우리나라에서는 겨울을 난다.

summary: 전국의 하천, 호소, 저수지에서 비교적 드물게 겨울을 나는 논병아리이다. 물고기, 연체동물, 물속 곤충 같은 동물성 먹이와 함께 거머리말 같은 수초도 먹는다. 한대 지역에서 2~3쌍이 모이거나 때로는 홀로 번식하며, 수초를 쌓은 뜬둥지에 알 4~5개를 낳아 암수가 20~24일 동안 함께 품는다. 겨울은 구북구의 온대와 열대에서 난다.

points.en: two buff plumes on the head (breeding)
black head, rufous neck and belly (breeding)
white cheeks and neck, black crown (winter)

art.subject: Horned Grebe (Podiceps auritus), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen in Korea from November to March: black cap from the forehead to the nape with a straight, sharp lower edge at eye level, so the eye sits on the border; cheeks, chin and throat clean white, the white cheek patch large and reaching up towards the nape; a narrow blackish stripe down the hindneck; foreneck white or faintly grey-washed; back and folded wings blackish-grey; breast and belly white, flanks mottled grey. Short, straight dark grey bill with a pale whitish tip; bright red iris; legs set far back and hidden underwater.
art.pose: swimming on open water, side view
art.scene: Korean winter reservoir with calm grey water and bare banks; no people, buildings or text
views: adult winter, side view swimming: black cap ending in a straight line at eye level, large clean white cheeks and throat, white foreneck, blackish-grey back, white breast, short straight pale-tipped bill, red eye, short neck held upright

adult breeding (March–April, before departure), side view swimming: black head with a dense golden-buff tuft running from the eye back to the rear of the crown on each side, chestnut-red neck, upper breast and flanks, blackish back, red eye
art.build: Small grebe, 30–39cm long, clearly larger than Little Grebe and much smaller than Great Crested Grebe; compact and buoyant on the water, with a large, flat-crowned head peaking at the rear and a short, fairly thin neck held upright. Bill shorter than the head, straight and fairly deep at the base, both mandibles straight to a fine point — not upturned. No visible tail; rear end rounded and fluffy. Lobed toes. Dives often. In flight shows white secondaries and a white patch on the leading edge of the inner wing.
avoid: Do not give it an upturned bill, a steep forehead with a peaked mid-crown, or dusky cheeks with black below the eye — those mark Black-necked Grebe (Podiceps nigricollis).
Do not paint a long slender neck or a long dagger bill like Great Crested Grebe.
Do not show the golden head tufts or chestnut neck on the winter plate bird; they appear only in breeding plumage.
Do not paint a yellow or dark eye; the iris is bright red.
